concurrency: Prior hypothetical work is not presumed completed. The immediate wave has Terra coordinator, Luna P01, P02, rerouted P03 and P06, plus Astra P10: six reasoning slots. P04 and P05 queue; if Sol review is needed, pause or queue lower-priority independent discovery to free a slot. Resource use remains bounded by six total reasoning conversations, four test processes after separate authorization, eight CPUs and 16 GiB; serialize shared build and nested output writers. The initial two-hour horizon does not reset.
reuse: Reuse the GUI-native conversation for paired direct/installed path mapping and provider for provider linkage. Use the consumer conversation for P06 configuration and inventory comparison; retain core and GUI-web findings and queue their related work. Terra keeps the earlier evidence ledger and compact cross-component alternatives with direct source access for Astra/Sol. Avoid duplicate provider searches by giving P02 the actual provider bridge and P06 consumer inventory/selection.

expert_and_human_triggers.astra: Dispatch bounded strategic consultation immediately: contrary consumer evidence and differing provider/test inventory expose a consequential uncertainty and a possible expensive wrong turn. A review by authorized Astra can satisfy a consequential decision gate; no mandatory screening wait.
expert_and_human_triggers.sol: Review any consequential architectural, algorithmic or measurement-contract decision before substantial dependent implementation; independent patch review and ownership of exhausted repair or consequential scope change. Queue Sol promptly if strategic discussion calls for it; free an existing slot.
expert_and_human_triggers.human: Request exact direct and installed consumer target identities, test inventories/logs, linked provider and library/package artifacts, valid edit/submit sequence and per-layer snapshots/trace, plus E1 missing information. Independent investigations continue while optional details are pending; missing answers do not authorize execution or changes.

Do not treat a direct GUI pass as installed consumer coverage or assert that proposed checks ran; do not erase E1 uncertainty.
Avoid unrelated broad matrices, full regression, release work, speculative patches and retained-kernel configure/compile/link/install; no tests or builds are executed in this study.
assumptions_and_uncertainties: E2 is fabricated external feedback, not a result of P03, P06, or P11. CI claims matching declared manifest and source revision, while provider and test inventory differ; exact runtime identity and responsible layer remain unknown.
E1 store and unmarked provider observations remain uncontrolled. Other reports remain unresolved until their own evidence is obtained.
Separate campaign authorization, enabled prerequisites and fixed scope remain necessary; no comparable prior Luna baseline is available.
